how_borders_were_found: neutral-dark columns (saturation < 6, value < 200) over the Blood strip; coloured cells are excluded by saturation, which is what a plain darkness test got wrong
verdict: Measured 123-125 columns (mode 124; all 5 strips agree exactly at the nominal borders, and the range is a +/-2 px sweep of both borders). Of the numbers this paper prints, NONE falls inside that range. Supplementary Table 3 lists 133 formulations, counted from native PDF text; the abstract says 122 LNPs were screened simultaneously. The figure's geometry supports NEITHER exactly: 133 and 134 are far outside, and 122 sits one column below the range. What is certain is that Figure 2 does NOT plot 133 LNPs, so the Conclusions' 'library of 133 distinct mRNA LNPs' is the number FORMULATED, not the number screened. The paper never reconciles them.
